bio: Prepare for an extraordinary culinary journey. In his cooking, Jan Hartwig harmoniously blends classic and modern elements, incorporating inspiring creative flourishes. His seven-course set menu is precisely crafted and carefully considered down to the last detail; each dish has its own identity and features wonderful – occasionally surprising – combinations. You have the option to add a signature dish such as sea urchin 'Louise', pâté en croûte or beef Wellington (for two people). An exquisitely delicate flavour profile is created, for example, by the delightfully tender pike and scallop dumpling, filled with deep green Tagetes oil and topped with slices of highly aromatic Atlantic mackerel, accompanied by an umami beurre blanc foam with a subtle acidity and a wonderful buttery note.
